name: OneDrive
summary: Manage your Microsoft OneDrive files with voice: list, search, read, download, upload, and share.
description: Connect your Microsoft account through Composio OAuth2 to browse folders, search documents, read and summarize Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and text files, download files to your Mac Downloads folder, upload notes, create directories, share links, and manage OneDrive items.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: API key starting with ak_ from your Composio Settings (https://app.composio.dev/settings).

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_USER_ID
preferences.title: Composio User ID
preferences.description: Optional user ID in Composio (e.g. 'default' or your connected account's user ID).

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_ID
preferences.title: Connected Account ID
preferences.description: Optional Composio connected account ID (starts with ca_). Leave blank to auto-detect your active OneDrive connection.

blocks.text:
1. Get your Composio API key from Settings at https://app.composio.dev/settings and paste it below.
2. In Composio, connect Microsoft OneDrive under Auth Configs (https://app.composio.dev).
3. Connected Account ID will be automatically discovered from your active connection, or you can paste your connected account ID directly.

tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List files and folder contents
tools.description: List files and folders inside a Microsoft OneDrive folder (root by default). Use when the user asks what's in their OneDrive or in a specific folder, or wants to browse directories. Each item comes back with a `path` to pass to download_file, create_share_link, or delete_file.

folder_path.description: OneDrive folder path relative to the root (e.g. 'Documents' or 'Documents/Projects'); leave empty for the root

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-20, default 8)

tools.name: search_files
tools.title: Search files
tools.description: Search Microsoft OneDrive for files and folders by keyword (matches names, metadata, and file contents). Use when the user wants to find or locate a file but doesn't know which folder it's in. Each result has an `id` (and usually a `path`) to pass to download_file, create_share_link, or delete_file.

query.description: Plain keywords or a file name (no wildcards or filters like 'filetype:')

tools.name: download_file
tools.title: Download file
tools.description: Download a file from Microsoft OneDrive into the Mac's ~/Downloads folder (never overwrites; adds ' (1)' if the name is taken). Use when the user asks to download, save locally, or fetch a OneDrive file. Pass a path or id from list_files/search_files; a bare file name also works if it's unique.

item_path.description: OneDrive path relative to the root (e.g. 'Documents/Report.pdf'), item id, or unique file name

file_name.description: Optional file name to save as inside ~/Downloads

tools.name: read_file
tools.title: Read file contents
tools.description: Read the text of a Microsoft OneDrive file so you can summarize it, answer questions about it, or quote from it. Works with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, and plain-text files (txt, md, csv, json, code); not images or scanned PDFs. Use when the user asks what a OneDrive file says, wants it summarized, or asks a question about its contents. Pass a path or id from list_files/search_files; a bare file name also works if it's unique.

item_path.description: OneDrive path relative to the root (e.g. 'Documents/Q3 Report.docx'), item id, or unique file name

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text to return (default 20000)

tools.name: upload_file
tools.title: Upload file
tools.description: Create a new plain-text file (e.g. .txt or .md) in Microsoft OneDrive from text the user dictates or that you compose. Use when the user asks to upload, create, write, or save a note or text file to OneDrive. Never overwrites: if the name is taken OneDrive picks a new one, which the result reports.

file_name.description: File name to create, including extension (e.g. 'Notes.md' or 'Summary.txt')

folder_path.description: Destination OneDrive folder path relative to the root (default: 'Documents'; '/' for the root)

root.html:
Upload to OneDrive
Creates a new file (renamed if the name is taken)

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Microsoft OneDrive. Use when the user asks to create, make, or add a folder in OneDrive. If the name is taken OneDrive picks a new one, which the result reports.

folder_name.description: Name of the folder to create (e.g. 'Projects' or 'Archive')

parent_path.description: Existing parent folder path relative to the root (e.g. 'Documents'); leave blank for the root

root.html:
Create OneDrive Folder
Creates new directory in OneDrive

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.title: Create share link
tools.description: Create a sharing link for a Microsoft OneDrive file or folder and copy it to the Mac clipboard. Use when the user asks to share a file, get a link to it, or let someone view or edit it. Who can open the link follows the account's default sharing settings. Pass a path or id from list_files/search_files; a bare file name also works if it's unique.

item_path.description: OneDrive path relative to the root (e.g. 'Documents/Report.docx'), item id, or unique file name

scope.description: Link permission: 'view' for read-only or 'edit' to allow editing (default: 'view')

root.html:
Create Sharing Link
Link will be copied to Mac clipboard

tools.name: delete_file
tools.title: Delete file
tools.description: Delete a file or folder in Microsoft OneDrive (moves it to the OneDrive recycle bin, where it can be restored). Use when the user asks to delete, remove, or trash a OneDrive item. Requires the exact path or id from list_files/search_files — never guess one from a bare name.

item_path.description: Exact OneDrive path relative to the root (e.g. 'Documents/Old.docx') or item id

root.html:
Delete from OneDrive
File or folder to delete:
Moves to the OneDrive recycle bin (restorable)
